title: Dov Lindqvist is in two places at once
explanation: Dov Lindqvist is at Greywater Dock in S01E01/sc/7 and at Marrow Street Garage in S01E01/sc/6 at the same story moment.
suggested_fix: Remove the character from one of the scenes, or separate the scenes in story time.

evidence.quote: I got here as fast as I could.
Dov and Rui argue quietly at Marrow Street Garage.
